blind.description: A stylized fantasy-style wall-mounted shop sign consisting of a horizontal wooden beam with a metal mounting plate and bolts at one end, two iron hanging straps, and a suspended shield-shaped sign. The sign face features a carved/painted potion bottle with herbal leaves on an off-white background with a reddish-brown trim on both sides. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal wooden beam with two dark grey metal brackets and a square mounting plate at the right end, with the top of the suspended shield sign visible below it.
defects: floating in mid-air without a supporting wall
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall and 2.5 feet wide, roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
